name: Spindle
description: Agent threads that run inside your browser, keep going while the panel is closed, read and act on the pages you allow, and move to and from Spindle on your machine.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https: data: blob:; style-src 'unsafe-inline' https: data: blob:; img-src https: data: blob:; font-src https: data: blob:; media-src https: data: blob:; connect-src https: data: blob:; worker-src data: blob:; frame-src https: data: blob:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
